scope: The homepage's Start Page tool card, rewritten once public v1.51.0 replaced the four Start Page layouts (Ledger, Billboard, Shelf, Tally) with one Start Page and widget cards. Retires v138-021 and v138-022.
qualification: v1.51.0's release notes: the Start Page is one page with the clock; Favorites and other devices' tabs are cards turned on in Customize, dragged to either side and resized. Time-of-day, your own image and color wallpapers, and the private-tab rule for your own image, are v1.38.0 claims (website-v1.38-claims.json) that v1.51.0 kept.

claims.exactWording: One Start Page with the clock at its center. Turn on Favorites and your other devices’ tabs as cards in Customize, then drag them to either side and resize them.
claims.subject: Blanc

claims.exactWording: Set the wallpaper to the time of day, your own image or a color.
